shape: A concert write-up in markdown: the brief, the person's own part stated plainly, how it was put on, how it went in figures, a named review and a recording's address.
tests: Layout: event. My role is the material's own words (concert manager), not a bigger one (the person did not conduct). No percentage of seats is worked out.

keyFacts.fact: The person was the concert manager.
96 tickets went to people who were not students, against 31 the year before.
The concert made £613 for the society (income £1,484, costs £871).
A public concert that paid for itself and brought in people from the town, on a budget of £900.

forbidden.why: The material says the person did not conduct or choose the music.
The material gives seats sold and no percentage, and the concert did not sell out.
